answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The ember holds work receipts rather than names, so the echo of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
